notes:
## New features

- None in this release.

## Changes

- New drawing settings default to 15° angle snapping. Existing saved angle preferences remain respected.
- Results use a clearer building → receptor → floor hierarchy. Clipboard and Excel rows retain assigned-building metadata, the original receptor ID and stack identity independently of visual grouping.
- P1999's diagonal shadow boundary was validated against the ISO 9613-2:2024 lateral diffraction limit and combined-path calculation. The standards-based attenuation transition is preserved. It is a prediction-method discontinuity, not a physically abrupt real-world sound boundary.

## Bug fixes

- Restyled standard hover help with compact rounded AURIS surfaces and subtle borders, including after map/WebEngine startup.

- Removed unnecessary GPU-runtime discovery from CPU-only receptor calculations, avoiding a cold-start delay in road calibration.
- Prevented Results tab loading from unintentionally activating the adjacent Contours tab during placeholder replacement.

- Fixed contour calculations failing when a small region beside a building has insufficient grid support. Additional receivers are calculated before the building-edge field is constructed.
- Fixed contour calculations overflowing when a model contains more than 63 acoustic transition boundaries.
- Fixed contour threshold endpoints anchoring to dangling diagnostic lines instead of the authoritative partition boundary.
- Fixed an invalid contour-band boundary caused by merging faces with roundoff-separated shared endpoints, while preserving the classified areas.
- Fixed tiny unclassifiable contour regions caused by rounding interpolation-mesh boundaries away from their authoritative partition.
- Contour progress distinguishes measured stage completion from finished contours. Unknown remaining work stays indeterminate; stage ETA follows measured throughput, and 100% is reserved for available results.
- Removed excess blank space below short dropdown lists, including Basemap and Slice.
- Dropdowns now retain the closed control's width and alignment when opened, including narrow toolbar controls.
- Idle footer messages now use the available width instead of truncating to “Sele…” or “Re…”, including after calculations and window resizing.
- Applying marker appearance settings refreshes the Editor, 3D view and contour sheet preview.
- Receptor stacks use one consecutive location number, with individual floor identifiers retained in results.
- Fullscreen windows use an opaque revealed titlebar and balanced spacing around the menu row. Windowed appearance is preserved.
